name: Shelumiel
title: Ancestor in the tribe of Asher
summary: Shelumiel was an Israelite from the tribe of Asher. His son Ahihud was appointed as tribal prince for Asher, responsible for distributing the inherited land in Canaan after the conquest. Shelumiel is mentioned in connection with the land distribution under Joshua's leadership.

keyEvents.title: Shelumiel's son appointed as tribal prince
keyEvents.description: Ahihud, son of Shelumiel, was appointed as prince for the tribe of Asher to distribute the land of Canaan among the children of Israel.

keyEvents.title: God's command regarding land distribution
keyEvents.description: The Lord gave Moses a command to appoint leaders from each tribe who would distribute inherited land in Canaan, which directly affected Shelumiel's family.

keyEvents.title: Boundaries of Canaan established
keyEvents.description: The boundaries of the promised land were set by God, and the tribal princes, including Shelumiel's son, were given responsibility for assigning territories.

keyEvents.title: Asher's tribal inheritance
keyEvents.description: The tribe of Asher, to which Shelomi belonged, received its inheritance in the promised land, a rich area along the coast in northern Canaan.
